shortDescription: Bihar Vidhan Parishad Security Guard Final Result 2026 is out for Advt. 03/2023 (about 56 posts). Check PDF on official portal.
content:
Bihar Vidhan Parishad has released the Security Guard Final Result 2026 for recruitment under Advt. No. 03/2023 (approximately 56 vacancies).

Candidates who appeared in the selection process including PET / written / interview stages (as applicable) can check the final list on the official Bihar Vidhan Parishad website.

Highlights

  • Post: Security Guard
  • Advertisement: 03/2023
  • Stage: Final Result / selection list
  • Document verification: follow dates notified on the official notice

How to check

  1. Visit the official Bihar Vidhan Parishad website
  2. Open Results / Notifications section
  3. Download Security Guard Final Result PDF (Advt. 03/2023)
  4. Search your roll number / name
  5. Report for document verification if selected as per schedule

Always rely on the official PDF for authentic selection status.
